thread:
Riley: Heads up  just watched a new developer hit the CLI onboarding. API returned 401 with JSON {"code":"auth.expired", "message":"key expired"} but the sample printed the whole JSON blob. Not great for first impressions.
June: Yikes. We should not dump raw bodies in the default UI. Tiny spec idea: SDKs surface typed exceptions + a small flat metadata bag.
Marco: Minimal exception classes: AuthError, RateLimitError, ClientInputError, ClientError, ServerError, StreamError, TransportError. Each exception must carry flat metadata keys only (strings/bools): status, code, retryable, retry_after, hint, request_id.
Sage: Important: "hint" is the user-facing short imperative (e.g., "Run `ri login` to refresh credentials."). Keep friendly copy out of metadata.code which is machine-only.
June: Also propose localization support: SDK provides a default English hint but apps can supply a localized mapping. SDK should not hardcode long sentences.
Riley: Implementation notes: map at transport boundary; do not convert 4xx to 5xx; parse Retry-After into seconds or ISO timestamp string; attach X-Request-Id from headers into request_id.
Marco: Pseudo mapping:
```
if status == 401:
  raise AuthError(msg or "authentication failed", status=str(status), code=body.get("code",""), retryable="false", hint="Run `ri login` to refresh your key.")
elif status == 429:
  raise RateLimitError(...)
```
Keep metadata flat strings.
Sage: UX rules for sample apps: show hint + one CTA for AuthError; show countdown when retry_after present for RateLimitError; inline validation for ClientInputError. No raw JSON in default render.
June: Telemetry: tag events with error_class and error_code. If we see an onboarding spike (e.g., >50 auth.expired/hr) auto-open INF ticket. error-bot: can you create one?
error-bot: (automated) created INF-9011: "SDK: error surface contract + localized hints" assigned to June.
Riley: I'll own the py change: add exceptions module, attach flat metadata, support optional localization hook, and make verbose body dumps opt-in (env var). ETA: 3 days. Draft PR will be posted here.
Marco: I'll add parity tests for node/go to assert classes and metadata keys are present and that __str__ is friendly by default.
Sage: Docs: small snippet showing how to switch on exception class then fallback to metadata.code for programmatic handling. Also a note: never show metadata.code to end users.
Riley: Great. Once PR's up we'll canary to staging and run the onboarding smoke. Thanks!
